text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin JF is a really big race. 
Trainer seemed super nervous too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...If only we had met after I was all 
grown up. Then maybe I could have put your 
mind at ease, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Why did we meet "now" of all times?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, I have to focus on the race right now. 
"It's okay, I believe in you"... I'm going 
to run for the Trainer who said that to 
me!
